biological_question: Does the macro descriptive mean and apparent night/day niche contrast change when multiple species sharing one original tracking field study are prevented from counting as independent source studies?

weights.taxon_within_original_study: one equal unit for each native taxon with an identifiable original outcome, no weighting by number of original GPS fixes or tags
weights.original_study: one equal weight for each DOI with at least one defined original outcome; missing egret retains a full study/hold row but not numeric zero
weights.confidence: 5000 descriptive bootstrap draws resampling original study source equal means; conditional on nonrandom study sampling, not world confidence or p values
weights.leave_one_source: remove each original source study in turn from fixed defined study frame; report range of simple source-equal pooled means
weights.alternative_naive: equal study×taxon rows with defined effect, show how multi-species Utah/Wyoming oversampling alters pooled effect

endpoints: original NIGHT-DAY log1p GPS step displacement speed q
raw cos(GPS travel bearing-Sun azimuth) study mean
joint circular covariance study mean (POINT_ONLY for original Utah/Wyoming; refrain from claiming source uncertainty)
limitations: First q/night-day points and original source-taxon animal bootstrap uncertainty are source conditional; study-equal confidence is descriptive study-block resampling conditional on fixed, purposive nonrandom source sample.
Reweighting study-vs-taxon does not establish a biological population average or control for study-protocol or season differences.
Source mean among taxa is not independent taxon replicates, and the source counts may still overlap actual ecological populations between publications.
Source effects are not comparable to latent activity duration, solar compass or direct animal received shortwave irradiance.
Do not average over unavailable source values as zero. The six new source prior source-only egret metadata-HOLD is retained.
No source bootstrapped CI should be described as a global hypothesis test. Old joint circular covariance missing within-source intervals remains point-only.
Earlier externally nonreplicated 48-source negative sunlight-direction result and 12 ERA5 SHA version holds remain unchanged.
